question: In the design round for a Software Engineer III (Java backend) role at Walmart, after a project discussion the candidate was asked to write fully working code for an LRU Cache where each operation has O(1) time complexity. As a follow-up, they were asked to modify the code to use generics for the key and value types.
lookingFor: Choosing the right data structure combination: hash map plus doubly linked list
Correct pointer manipulation and edge cases, written as working code
Generalising the class with generics cleanly
Awareness of thread safety and what changes in a concurrent setting
Testing mentally with a sequence of operations
followUps: How would you make this thread-safe without a single global lock?
How would you add a TTL (expiry) to each entry?
What changes for an LFU cache and how do you keep it O(1)?
How would you test this class?
